name: Portal
summary: The Next.js 15 portal where people sign up, create and pay for an OTA, manage its keys, domains, connections, team and billing, go live and open the OTA admin; a backend-for-frontend of the platform API.

local.notes: Binds 127.0.0.1:3000. Needs the platform API on 127.0.0.1:3100 (and its worker), Mailpit on :8025 for e-mail links, and for provisioning the OTA worker and the Amadeus stub. Configuration comes from the root .env.local (or platform/frontend/.env.local).

talksTo.how: Server-side REST calls to PLATFORM_API_URL /v1 (Bearer from the __Host-vxp_at cookie, X-Velexis-End-User-IP/-Agent and X-Velexis-Bff-Key)
Open console: the hand-off page posts a one-time portalToken (ptk_) to PUBLIC_OTA_ADMIN_URL/sso; the OTA admin sends people without a session to /console?tenant=
Links only: the dashboard links https://<key>.<STOREFRONT_BASE_DOMAIN>/, the OTA overview and set-up page https://<primaryHost>/
Caddy proxies platform.example.com to 127.0.0.1:3000; systemd unit velexis-portal.service; deploy.sh polls /health/ready

data: redis mfach:*, ptk:*, stripe:oauth:*, vx:idem:* (via the API)

roles.name: Visitor (no session)
roles.can: Public pages, sign up, sign in, password reset, look up an invitation

roles.name: Unverified account
roles.can: Only /verify-pending (resend the link) and sign out

roles.name: Verified account
roles.can: My OTAs, create an OTA (up to MAX_TENANTS_PER_ACCOUNT), profile, security, accept invitations

roles.name: Owner
roles.can: Everything of the OTA: keys, domains, connections, team incl. owners/admins, billing, payout account, go live, retry set-up, reveal test keys

roles.name: Admin
roles.can: Profile, API keys, domains, Amadeus and payment settings, team (agents, finance, viewers); no billing, payout, settlements or go-live

roles.name: Finance
roles.can: Overview, domains, Amadeus and payments (read), billing (read), payout account and settlements (read)

screens.title: Privacy notice
screens.purpose: Placeholder privacy notice

screens.title: Verify your e-mail address

screens.purpose: Request a reset link; same confirmation for every address

screens.title: Overview

screens.title: OTA set-up

screens.title: Team

screens.title: Your profile
